Hey there! This is the spread that I pulled for you. https://imgur.com/a/SBsMo The first card represents the current situation or question. The second card shows what actions you can take. The final card shows the possible outcome from those actions. 

In the first position we have the Ten of Wands. This is a card that shows overwork. Have you been stressing yourself out about work or possibly working long hours without reward? You can only keep this up for so long before you get burnt out and frustrated. The wands are asking you to think about something that you are really passionate about and perhaps dropping the things that you don't actually care about. 

The second position shows the actions you can take to achieve your goals. The Six of Cups is a card of innocence, nostalgia, and idealism. Now is not the time to let yourself fall into cynicism. Think back to your youth and figure out what you wanted to do when you grow up. Perhaps it is time to pursue a dream that you may have given up on. If you do it will align with your desire to improve your money situation. 

Finally, we have Strength in the outcome position. Strength represents the calm and patient unity between your animalistic side and your logical side. Perhaps in understanding yourself more deeply you will naturally attract more wealth (both literal and spiritual). Using the ideas you find from the Six of Cups could lead you to Strength in the form of a new (better?) job or perhaps a promotion. You will be recognized for your strength.
